From 783cf673b05ebf290317f583ee7eb6967ed9c964 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Weihang Li <liweihang@huawei.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2021 10:44:29 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] RDMA/hns: Fix memory corruption when allocating XRCDN

It's incorrect to cast the type of pointer to xrcdn from (u32 *) to
(unsigned long *), then pass it into hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(), this will
lead to a memory corruption.

Fixes: 32548870d438 ("RDMA/hns: Add support for XRC on HIP09")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1616381069-51759-1-git-send-email-liweihang@huawei.com
Reported-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Weihang Li <liweihang@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Leon Romanovsky <leonro@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
index 3ca51ce1813a..a5813bf567b2 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c
@@ -140,8 +140,16 @@ void hns_roce_cleanup_uar_table(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev)
 
 static int hns_roce_xrcd_alloc(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev, u32 *xrcdn)
 {
-	return hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap,
-				     (unsigned long *)xrcdn);
+	unsigned long obj;
+	int ret;
+
+	ret = hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap, &obj);
+	if (ret)
+		return ret;
+
+	*xrcdn = obj;
+
+	return 0;
 }
 
 static void hns_roce_xrcd_free(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev,
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/hw/hns/hns_roce_pd.c`**
   - The function `hns_roce_xrcd_alloc` has been modified:
     - The previous implementation incorrectly cast the pointer `xrcdn` from `u32 *` to `(unsigned long *)` when calling `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()`, which could lead to memory corruption.
     - The new implementation introduces a local variable `obj` of type `unsigned long` to store the result of `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()`.
     - The function now checks the return value of `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()`. If it is successful, it assigns the value of `obj` to the dereferenced `xrcdn` pointer.
     - The function returns `0` on success or the error code from `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()` on failure.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `hns_roce_xrcd_alloc` directly addresses the bug reported regarding memory corruption. By changing the way the pointer is handled and ensuring that the correct type is used, the patch prevents the potential corruption that could occur from the incorrect casting. This change improves the safety and correctness of memory allocation within the RDMA/hns driver. The patch is linked to a specific commit that introduced the bug, indicating that this fix is a direct response to that earlier change.

Here is the commit message:
RDMA/hns: Fix memory corruption when allocating XRCDN

It's incorrect to cast the type of pointer to xrcdn from (u32 *) to
(unsigned long *), then pass it into hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(), this will
lead to a memory corruption.

Fixes: 32548870d438 ("RDMA/hns: Add support for XRC on HIP09")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/1616381069-51759-1-git-send-email-liweihang@huawei.com
Reported-by: Dan Carpenter <dan.carpenter@oracle.com>
Signed-off-by: Weihang Li <liweihang@huawei.com>
Reviewed-by: Leon Romanovsky <leonro@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@nvidia.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly casting a pointer of type `u32 *` to `unsigned long *` when passing it to the `hns_roce_bitmap_alloc()` function. This type mismatch can lead to memory corruption, as the function expects a pointer of a different type than what was provided, potentially causing incorrect memory access or manipulation.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int hns_roce_xrcd_alloc(struct hns_roce_dev *hr_dev, u32 *xrcdn)
 {
-	return hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap,
-				     (unsigned long *)xrcdn);
+	unsigned long obj;
+	int ret;
+
+	ret = hns_roce_bitmap_alloc(&hr_dev->xrcd_bitmap, &obj);
+	if (ret)
+		return ret;
+
+	*xrcdn = obj;
+
+	return 0;
 }
